TLA+/TLC and Agda are not selected: no concurrency or proof obligation beyond the finite resolver. Liveness is not applicable: the resolver is a pure synchronous total function and the Wait outcome is left by the access read, which is the existing useRbac() effect outside this design. Executable projection of the model is the resolver table and seeded property test in the S1 oracle.

facts.F31: OO reading: no domain entity changes; the decision owners are the definition and resolver in models (data plus its pure decision), the shell for presentation, hooks for server state. Smell classes applied from nw-code-design-oo: feature envy on route literals (moved to the definition), shotgun surgery on paths (one owner), long components (extract section from OverviewDashboard).
